description: Manages APT repositories using apt-repo tool.

parameters.name: remove_others
parameters.description: Remove other then added repositories. Used if state=present. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Name of the repository to add or remove.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Indicates the desired repository state. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: update
parameters.description: Update the package database after changing repositories. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Remove all repositories
  community.general.apt_repo:
    repo: all
    state: absent

- name: Add repository `Sisysphus` and remove other repositories
  community.general.apt_repo:
    repo: Sisysphus
    state: present
    remove_others: true

- name: Add local repository `/space/ALT/Sisyphus` and update package cache
  community.general.apt_repo:
    repo: copy:///space/ALT/Sisyphus
    state: present
    update: true
